extracted.stage: Financial provision action proceeding to proof
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for the pursuer in a financial provision action at Edinburgh Sheriff Court asks whether we lend in Scotland, seeking £35,500 against matrimonial property of about £355,000.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the details of your client's financial provision action. To consider the matter further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court handling the proceedings, details of the matrimonial property and how it is held, the procedural stage and any fixed diet or proof dates, and an estimate of costs to conclusion. It would also help to have your client's details and your firm's confirmation that you are instructed. Please note we are not able to indicate at this stage whether funding can be offered or on what terms. A member of our team will come back to you once we have reviewed the information provided.
